name: Scalenut
tagline: Scalenut is an AI content platform that combines SEO research with AI writing. It analyses top-ranking pages for any keyword, builds a content brief with NLP-extracted topics, then helps writers produce optimised articles. Its Cruise Mode generates a full 1,500-word blog post from a keyword in under five minutes.
